description: Main FastAPI backend source file for a Tic Tac Toe game, defining endpoints for user registration, login, game creation, moves, leaderboard, and game history.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple message.

methods.name: register(user: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creating user and leaderboard entry.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Handles user login and JWT token generation.

methods.name: str get_symbol_for_user(game: models.Game, user_id)
methods.description: Determines if the user is 'X' or 'O' in a game.

methods.name: board_from_moves(moves)
methods.description: Constructs a 3x3 game board from move data.

methods.name: check_winner(board)
methods.description: Checks the current board for a winner.

methods.name: is_full(board)
methods.description: Determines if the game board is full.

methods.name: new_game(game_req: schemas.GameCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new game, single- or multiplayer, with matchmaking for multiplayer.

methods.name: _game_to_response(game: models.Game)
methods.description: Converts a game model instance to response schema including moves.

methods.name: make_move(game_id: int, move: schemas.MoveCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles a player's move, updates game state, checks for win/tie, and AI move in single-player.

methods.name: get_leaderboard(db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Returns sorted leaderboard based on wins.

methods.name: get_history(db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves game history for the current authenticated user.
